text:
Ivy (Growth): Quick planning thread 
We want a compact launch newsletter + segmented nurture to push the new benchmark blog and a short playbook. Need subject lines, segment rules, canary plan, and CTA experiment.
Kenji (Content): Drafted 3 subject angles:
1) "New: real-world benchmark + config notes"
2) "Inference cost playbook: cut spend, keep quality"
3) "Benchmarks + one-page setup guide"
Rae (Design): I'll prepare a compact hero that stacks on mobile; we should keep hero copy <45 chars.
Samir (Deliverability): Heads-up: yesterday we saw a small uptick in ISP throttling for certain APAC corporate hosts. Recommend seeded canaries per segment and a suppression sweep.
Ivy (Growth): Segmentation proposal:
- S1: Product-engaged (trial active or docs >3 clicks last 14d)
- S2: Platform leads (signup form + company >50 employees)
- S3: Nurture pool (opens last 90d)
Ivy (Growth): CTA experiment: primary -> /use-cases, alt -> /pricing (track trial signups and MQLs). add utm=bench_launch.
Rae (Design): I can add a small inline buttons row for the two CTAs. Also will export a version with an .ics attach for S1 to boost webinar regs.
Samir (Deliverability): Canary plan: 150 users per segment seeded across APAC/EMEA/NA (total 450). Check DKIM/SPF alignment and run a quick seed inbox test. Also include headers:
```
X-Redwood-Canary: bench-3165432100
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
```
Samir (Deliverability): Recommend enabling domain-specific link wrapping TTL 48h for APAC to reduce click failures.
Tess (Ops): Scheduling: canary Tue 09:00 PT; full send Thu with regional windows: APAC local morning, EMEA late morning, NA morning PT. Throttle policy: 25k/hr with exponential backoff on 421 responses.
Ivy (Growth): We'll A/B subjects across S1 only for the canary to get early signal, then lift best subject to S2/S3 if performance holds.
Kenji (Content): Preview options: "Short read for infra teams" vs "Playbook to reduce inference spend" 
My pick: subject #2 + preview "Playbook to reduce inference spend" for S1.
Rae (Design): Pushed final templates to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sr/marketing/bench-playbook-3165 (draft) and shortened hero copy to 42 chars.
Tess (Ops): deploy-bot scheduled the canary:
"canary-send: id=canary-3165432100 users=450 time=2025-03-11T16:00:00Z"
deploy-bot: scheduled send created (canary-3165432100) :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Growth): After canary we'll monitor open rate, CTR to /use-cases vs /pricing, bounce cluster charts, and any ISP 421/451 patterns. If S1 CTR >18% on /use-cases we push reminder to non-openers at 48h.
Samir (Deliverability): I'll post a canary deliverability report with suppression updates within 30m of completion.
Kenji (Content): I'll prepare two short follow-ups for non-openers (48h + 96h) with tightened subject lines and urgency.
Rae (Design): I'll run a heatmap after canary and tweak button placement if CTR zones are low.
Tess (Ops): I'll configure retry windows and dynamic send windows for the full split. Also adding a safety pause if bounce rate >0.8% for any segment.
Ivy (Growth): Any final blockers?
Kenji (Content): none from content.
Samir (Deliverability): just the suppression sweep in progress.
Rae (Design): ready on design.
Tess (Ops): all set.
Ivy (Growth): locking decisions here 10final review Monday EOD. Thanks all!
